$comment: The toon objects: the brand's 3D sticker art and the toon style that turns any picture into one (brand/illustration.md). Subjects are the image editor's own stickers (agd-playground public/agentcard-og/*.webp, served on agentcard.sh), converted to PNG. Compositions are the editor's sticker arrangements: preset (the hero's margins), scatter (seeded, clear of each other), under (one large object), row and single are plain arrangements of the same objects.
source: agd-playground src/components/agentcard-og/draw.ts (STICKERS, scatter, underneath), Editor.tsx (HERO_STICKERS), toon.ts (toonify); public/agentcard-og

compositions.single: One object, large and tilted a little, in the middle of the ground.
compositions.under: One object, large, in the lower part of the ground (the social hero's arrangement).
compositions.preset: The hero's seven objects in the margins (Editor.tsx HERO_STICKERS).
compositions.scatter: Objects scattered without overlapping, from a seed (draw.ts scatter).
compositions.row: Objects side by side on one line, alternating tilts.
